From: Marcelo Alvarez <marcelo@medflow.com>

Subject: CCPA/CPRA - data exports & technical controls (addendum RFI)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking this. As part of MedFlow's vendor privacy review for our pilot, legal & privacy have a few specific asks so we can finalize the US-state addendum (CCPA/CPRA). Could you confirm the following and provide artifacts where possible:

1) Role classification: confirm Redwood's role under CCPA/CPRA (Service Provider / Third Party).
2) Subprocessors: current list of subprocessors (name + regions) and a process/lead time for notices on new subprocessors.
3) Data export proof: a redacted sample showing exported user data flows (logs or export job metadata) and a short explanation of how we can verify a completed export.
4) Deletion / retention: the technical steps you take to delete customer data on request and an example deletion certificate or audit entry.
5) Encryption & keys: TLS versions/cipher suites in use for in-transit, encryption-at-rest details, and whether keys are customer-managed (KMS/HSM) or Redwood-managed.
6) Cross-state transfers: any known interstate routing paths or fallbacks and whether you can commit to an onshore fallback for data from Calif.-resident users.
7) Evidence: SOC2 or similar report availability (NDA req?) and a point of contact for a technical deep dive.

Attachments we expect (not required in your first reply, but helpful): current subprocessor roster, network diagram showing regions/VPC zones, KMS/key rotation doc, a small redacted audit log sample, and any template attestation you typically sign.

Timeline: our legal team is hoping to close the addendum within two weeks. Can you let me know what you can provide and a rough ETA?

Thanks —
Marcelo
Marcelo Alvarez
Head of Privacy & Risk, MedFlow Health
marcelo@medflow.com

Subject: Re: CCPA/CPRA - data exports & technical controls (addendum RFI)

Marcelo — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below and I copied our privacy/ops leads so we can turn this into a technical package quickly.

1) Role: Redwood operates as a Service Provider under CCPA/CPRA for hosted customers; we accept processing instructions and do not use customer data for advertising. We can add contract language in the addendum to codify that.

2) Subprocessors: attached is the current roster (redwood_subprocessors_2026-07.csv). Notices on new subprocessors are provided per our DPA timeline (30 days notice for non-emergency additions).

3) Data export proof: we'll provide a redacted sample audit/log bundle showing export-job entries and S3 export metadata (audit_log_sample_202606.tar.gz). That will include timestamps, job IDs and hashes you can use to verify integrity.

4) Deletion: we have automated deletion workflows tied to customer deletion requests and a deletion certificate pattern we can produce. Laura will lead on the attestation template.

5) Encryption & keys: TLS 1.2+ (TLS 1.3 preferred) with modern cipher suites; AES-256 at rest. Keys are Redwood-managed by default using cloud KMS; we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) on Dedicated and Private deployments — we'll include KMS/HSM details in the attached policy (kms_key_rotation_policy_2026-07.pdf).

6) Cross-state transfers: routing is regional. For US customers we can commit to onshore fallback routes in our Hosted US region; details in the network diagram (network_diagram_vpc_zones.png).

7) Evidence: SOC2 report is available under NDA; we can provide access once appropriate agreements are in place.

Next steps: Naomi is preparing a redacted audit sample and I'll follow up with Laura on the deletion attestation. Can we schedule a 30-min technical call? I can do the following windows (PST): Mon Aug 2 09:00-10:30, Tue Aug 3 13:00-15:00, Wed Aug 4 08:00-10:00.

I'll attach the preliminary artifacts in a single package once we have legal sign-off on redaction.

Regards,
Vivek
Sr. Director, Trust & Security — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_2026-07.csv; network_diagram_vpc_zones.png; kms_key_rotation_policy_2026-07.pdf
